text:
Eli (CS): Drafting a lean customer-facing 'lightning primer' for first-14-day activation. Goal: get customers live with minimal ops friction while surfacing renewal signals. Sharing for quick edits.

Priya (Solutions): Nice. Recommend we call out a synthetic warmup step customers can run to populate KV cache & warm pools.

Eli (CS): Added. Step: run 50 synthetic requests over 10s with common prefixes to seed prefetch + KV.

Marco (Infra): Add safe defaults for customers who don't want to warm pools: prefetch.top_k=3, prefetch.ttl_s=180, batching.max_size=8, batching.latency_ms=50. Also suggest a low-cost quantized variant for burst fallback.

Tessa (CS): For renewal signal, capture these 3 events: weekly_active_sessions, avg_tokens_per_session, first-response-failure-rate. We'll map thresholds to risk tiers.

Eli (CS): Love the simple event list. Also adding a quick QA harness snippet they can run:
```bash
# quick warmup script
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"Hi, show me docs for X","prefetch":true}';
  sleep 0.2
done
```

Marco (Infra): Ops note: ask customers to forward logs with fields request_id, p95_latency_ms, cache_hit(true/false), model_name. Those let us correlate low-engagement vs perf issues.

Priya (Solutions): Add UX guidance: prefer streaming for discovery flows (search/browse) and full-response for single-answer accuracy. Streaming reduces perceived latency.

Tessa (CS): Day map suggestion: Day0 API smoke test; Day1 enable prefetch + run warmup; Day3 validate metrics pipeline; Day7 NPS + qualitative feedback; Day14 risk review and offer targeted enablement.

Eli (CS): Escalation play: risk if (NPS<=3 OR weekly_sessions<5) AND p95_latency>750ms -> auto-create triage ticket to CSM+SE+Infra. Aim TTR = 48h.

Marco (Infra): Recommend customers set client-side concurrency cap during ramp: 40 RPS. Circuit breaker values: error_rate=0.06, window_s=45, backoff=exp(150ms,1.5s).

Priya (Solutions): Capture a short email/Slack template for Day7 outreach asking for a 2-min call and quick log snippet. Include link to a one-click diagnostics export.

Eli (CS): Troubleshooting mini-list for customer docs:
- No cache hits: verify prefix normalization + send common-sample corpus.
- Spiky latency: lower batch size or enable streaming.
- Low engagement: ensure welcome prompt is surfaced and NPS delivered.

ops-bot: FYI: if you enable streaming for a workspace, post a short change note in #streaming-features; oncall follow-up in 24h.

Tessa (CS): I'll turn this into a two-page PDF and a short checklist for CSM handoff. Will ping when uploaded.

Eli (CS): Thanks all. We'll measure cohort activation (day7 active %) and renewal-risk delta at day30. Ping here if you want edits before I push to enablement.
